Airway epithelial cells of smokers and never smokers from the Human Lung Cell Atlas

Source: R/data-docs.R
hlca_airway_subset.Rd

A SingleCellExposomeExperiment with the raw counts of 352 tracheal epithelial cells from 12 donors of the Human Lung Cell Atlas (HLCA) core: six heavy smokers and six never smokers, with up to 10 basal, 10 secretory and 10 multiciliated-lineage cells per donor. It is a small real data set for the vignettes and the tests. It shows how the functions are used on real counts; with 12 donors and at most 10 cells per donor and cell type it is far too small to support conclusions about smoking.

Format

An RDS file, inst/extdata/hlca_airway_subset.rds, read with readRDS(system.file("extdata", "hlca_airway_subset.rds", package = "exposomeSC")).

Source

The CELLxGENE H5AD of the HLCA core, dataset version 688185ad-11c2-4172-a53a-f4f1f4076860 (https://datasets.cellxgene.cziscience.com/688185ad-11c2-4172-a53a-f4f1f4076860.h5ad, 5,873,612,847 bytes, SHA-256 1cbdde1e513a31bdb6a3f70296e2d0612760d2af4032e239c94596ea87b44007), distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The subset was made by inst/scripts/make_hlca_airway_subset.R, which checks the file and carries out the selection described above. Cells and genes were selected; the counts themselves are unchanged.

Details

Cells

Study "Seibold_2020" of the HLCA core (Goldfarbmuren et al. 2020): the heavy smokers T85, T90, T101, T120, T154 and T167 (smokers with at least 15 pack-years) and the never smokers T126, T137, T153, T164, T165 and T166, the two groups that the authors compare, as classified in their public metadata. The other two donors of the study in the atlas, a light smoker and a child who never smoked, are left out. Cells annotated "Basal", "Secretory" or "Multiciliated lineage" at HLCA annotation level 3 were eligible, and up to 10 per donor and cell type were drawn at random with a fixed seed, without looking at expression; donor T154 has only two multiciliated-lineage cells. The donors and the cell types were fixed before any result on cells of these donors was seen. The number of cells per donor and cell type was set later, by the size limit of a Bioconductor source package: before this subset was drawn, but after the smoking model had been run on larger sets of cells of the same donors.

Counts

assay(x, "counts"): the raw counts of the H5AD (/raw/X), 20,111 genes by 352 cells, as a sparse matrix. Genes without a count in these cells are left out, so the column sums are those of the complete transcriptome. The rows are Ensembl gene identifiers. rowData(x)$symbol holds the gene names of the atlas (feature_name): for 2,301 genes that name is the Ensembl identifier again, and three names (MATR3, RAET1E-AS1 and SPATA13) are each on two rows.

Cell annotations

colData(x): donor_id (the donor code of the study), cell_type, assay (10x 3' v2 or v3) and hlca_donor_id (the donor identifier of the HLCA).

Donor variables

exposureData(x), one row per donor: smoking (1 = heavy smoker, 0 = never smoker), chemistry_v3 (1 = 10x 3' v3, 0 = 10x 3' v2), age (years) and sex_male (1 = male, 0 = female).

Provenance

metadata(x)$source: the URL, dataset version, size and SHA-256 of the H5AD, the licence, the references, the selection rule and, in eligible_cells, the number of eligible cells of each donor and cell type in the atlas (29,217 in all), from which the cells of the subset were drawn.

References

Sikkema L, et al. (2023). An integrated cell atlas of the lung in health and disease. Nature Medicine, 29, 1563-1577. doi:10.1038/s41591-023-02327-2

Goldfarbmuren KC, et al. (2020). Dissecting the cellular specificity of smoking effects and reconstructing lineages in the human airway epithelium. Nature Communications, 11, 2485. doi:10.1038/s41467-020-16239-z

Examples

x <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "hlca_airway_subset.rds",
    package = "exposomeSC"))
x
#> class: SingleCellExposomeExperiment 
#> dim: 20111 352 
#> metadata(1): source
#> assays(1): counts
#> rownames(20111): ENSG00000000003 ENSG00000000419 ... ENSG00000283103
#>   ENSG00000283125
#> rowData names(1): symbol
#> colnames(352): TCTTCCTTCAGAGCAG_T101 CTACTATCAACGGGTA_T101 ...
#>   CCTCTAGAGCAAGCCA_T90 CCTCATGGTCTACATG_T90
#> colData names(4): donor_id cell_type assay hlca_donor_id
#> reducedDimNames(0):
#> mainExpName: NULL
#> altExpNames(0):
#> exposureData(12 samples x 4 exposures): smoking, chemistry_v3, age, sex_male
#> sampleColumn: donor_id
table(x$donor_id, x$cell_type)

exposureData(x)
